summary: Three children, ages 9, 6 and 6, were reported missing from a family campsite near the Midland Bike Trail east of Buena Vista on September 26, 2026. Sheriff’s deputies, Chaffee County SAR volunteers, drones, a helicopter and K9 Arch searched the area. The children were located about 1.5 miles from camp around 2 p.m., uninjured, and reunited with their family.
location: Midland Bike Trail, east of Buena Vista
responding_agency: Chaffee County Sheriff's Office / Chaffee County Search and Rescue
notes: The sheriff’s public post preview confirms the September 26, 2026 report at about 11 a.m. The linked September 29 secondary report corroborates the response and recovery; the original full Facebook post was not accessible during this review.
